changes.new_statement: An applicant younger than eighteen must wait fifteen full days after a failed knowledge exam. After three failures, a fourth attempt requires passing classroom driver education or a DMV-approved eight-hour manual course. Adults may use that course; younger applicants need prior classroom completion. The manual course must be completed after the third failure, and its certificate goes to DMV.
